summary: The prompt systematically trusts boundaries that cut before clause heads, particles, or disambiguating PPs (priority problem) and sometimes places boundaries that split verbs from their particles/objects or emit negation/subordinators too early (placement problem). Also ensure tags never alter original punctuation/spacing (format violation). Adjust ranking to demote boundaries in those contexts and delay finalizing translations until the dependent token(s) arrive.
